title: Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts Models: Expert Bytes, Kernel Bandwidth and the Best Draft Length
abstract: arXiv:2610.34440v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding checks several drafted tokens in one verification pass. On a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, consecutive tokens often select the same experts. A deduplicating engine reads each selected expert once per pass, so it requests fewer bytes than a per-slot engine, which reads it once per token. We write a step's time as the bytes each kernel requests over its effective bandwidth, plus fixed time. Under geometric acceptance, we derive from this step time when speculation is faster than plain decoding. The best draft length is a monotone staircase in the acceptance rate. We bound how a bandwidth error moves each result, and we check the main steps in Lean. Deduplication is faster exactly where its share $\bar u(n)$ of the per-slot bytes is below its ratio $r(n)$ of the per-slot bandwidth. translated_title: 面向混合专家模型的投机解码：专家字节量、内核带宽与最佳草稿长度
translated_abstract: 投机解码在一次验证过程中检查多个草拟的token。在混合专家模型上，连续的token往往选择相同的专家。去重引擎在每轮验证中对每个被选中的专家只读取一次，因此其请求的字节数少于逐槽引擎，后者每处理一个token都要读取一次。我们将一步的耗时表示为每个内核在其有效带宽下所请求的字节数再加上固定时间。在几何接受分布假设下，我们基于该步时模型推导出投机解码何时快于普通解码。最佳草稿长度是关于接受率的单调阶梯函数。我们给出了带宽误差对每个结果影响的界，并用Lean对主要步骤进行了形式化验证。当去重引擎的字节占比 $\bar u(n)$ 低于其带宽比值 $r(n)$ 时，去重恰好更快。在我们改造为去重版本的 llama.cpp Metal、MLX-LM 和 llama.cpp CUDA 上，逐槽内核拥有更高的有效带宽（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文为混合专家模型的投机解码建立了“内核请求字节量除以有效带宽”的解析步时模型，推导出去重读取专家比逐槽读取更快的精确条件，并证明最佳草稿长度随接受率呈单调阶梯变化，主要推导经Lean形式化验证。
en_tdlr: This paper builds an analytical step-time model for speculative decoding in MoE models—each kernel's requested bytes over its effective bandwidth—deriving the exact condition under which expert-deduplicating decoding beats per-slot reading, showing the best draft length is a monotone staircase in the acceptance rate, with key results formally verified in Lean.
